title: On a phone the Events page opens with one sticky toolbar, a Filters sheet and quick date chips, so the first event shows on the first screen

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14, on Android, /events: Completely re think and condense this sort menu. Do best practice for mobile.

detail: Before any event, a phone stacked the search and home base, New event, Subscribe, Manage and Drafts, the category tabs, six facet chips (Format, Date, Price, Pace, Spots, Sort) and the List / Map / Calendar switch, so the first card sat below the fold. The Frequency body now draws one toolbar that sticks under the header (the member header, or the site header for a signed-out visitor, following it as it hides): the search, a Filters button with a badge counting the set filters, the view switch (icons on a phone, each still named List, Map or Calendar for a screen reader) and, for a signed-in member only, one More menu holding New event, Drafts and Manage (once they have added an event, as before) and Subscribe to calendar (which draws itself only for a member). Under 768px the category tabs and facet chips leave the page for a bottom sheet behind Filters (components/frequency/members/events/events-filter-sheet.tsx): a native modal dialog (focus moves in and stays, Escape or a tap on the scrim closes it, focus returns to Filters, it closes if the screen grows past 768px) holding category, date, price, format, pace, spots, location (home base and distance) and sort as radio chips with their real counts, Clear all, and an Apply button that says Show N events when the count is already known (nothing changed, or one facet changed, from facetCounts) and Show results otherwise. The sheet is one GET form to /events with the same param keys and values, so filtering stays in getEventsIndexData and links, refresh and back / forward keep working; empty choices are dropped before submit. A scrolling row of quick chips carries the active category (tap to clear) and Today, This week and This weekend as toggles. The title shrinks to h2 and the intro clamps to two lines on a phone. From 768px the sheet and quick chips go and the category tabs and facet menus sit inline as before, under the same toolbar. The operator CTA, when set, stays a small button under the intro. Colours are surface, text and members ink tokens only, so the sheet and toolbar follow dark mode. /events reads no new cookies or headers. DAWN is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'):'';const b=r('components/frequency/members/events/events-body.tsx');const s=r('components/frequency/members/events/events-filter-sheet.tsx');const c=r('app/themes/frequency/members-events.css');const bad=[];if(!b.includes('className=\"ev-tb\"')||!b.includes('<FqEventsFilterSheet'))bad.push('no single toolbar with a Filters sheet');if(!s.includes('showModal()')||!s.includes('method=\"GET\"'))bad.push('the sheet is not a modal dialog over the URL form');if(b.includes('<Link className=\"btn glass\" href=\"/drafts\">')||b.includes('<Link className=\"btn glass\" href=\"/admin/events\">'))bad.push('host actions still stack as buttons');const m=b.indexOf('<details className=\"fqm-menu ev-more\">');const more=m<0?'':b.slice(m,m+1400);if(m<0||!b.slice(m-80,m).includes('myProfileId &&')||!more.includes('href=\"/events/new\"')||!more.includes('userHasEvents &&')||!more.includes('<CalendarSubscribe'))bad.push('host actions are not one gated More menu');if(!b.includes('className=\"evf-quick\"'))bad.push('no quick chips row');const wide=c.slice(c.indexOf('@media (min-width:768px){'));const narrow=c.slice(c.indexOf('@media (max-width:767.98px){'));if(!c.includes('.ev-tb{position:sticky')||c.indexOf('@media (min-width:768px){')<0||!wide.slice(0,400).includes('.evf-quick{display:none}')||c.indexOf('@media (max-width:767.98px){')<0||!narrow.slice(0,3000).includes('.ev-facets{display:none}'))bad.push('the phone and desktop layouts do not split at 768px');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-919: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
